name: Dye Vat
summary: A colour and size picker where the kurta dips into a dye tub and a tape measure picks the size
about: A product option picker for a block-print kurta. Choosing a colour lowers the kurta on its rope into a steaming dye tub, splashes, and lifts it out while the new dye wicks up the fabric and drips back in. A brass marker slides along a tape measure to pick the size, the kurta grows or shrinks to match, and Add to bag flies a folded kurta into a real bag with steppers and a PKR total.
how: Press a colour swatch or use the arrow keys: the tub takes the dye, the kurta dips, rises and drips
Pick a size on the tape measure: the marker springs to it, the kurta resizes and L and XL add PKR 200
Jade in XL is sold out: its chip is struck through and the button tells you to try another size
Press Add to bag: a folded kurta flies into the bag, the same colour and size stack into one line
Use + and − on a bag line; going to zero slides the line out and the total rolls to the new sum
